name: code_read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset (and other) email links are built from `BASE_URL`, which falls back to `http://localhost:3000` whenever the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable is not set in the deployment environment. This explains why links are pointing to localhost for users since the last release — the production environment is likely missing `PUBLIC_URL`, so the code silently falls back to the development default instead of failing loudly. Recommend setting `PUBLIC_URL` correctly in the production config and/or making the code throw or warn at startup when it's unset in a non-local environment.

input.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this fallback is used to build the password reset link (and other links like /reports and /reports/${report.id}). In production the PUBLIC_URL environment variable apparently isn't being set (or isn't reaching this module), so reset emails end up pointing at localhost instead of the real public URL.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL (or an equivalent configured base URL, e.g. config.publicUrl) is always set correctly in the production environment, and consider making templates.ts fail fast or log a warning if it falls back to localhost outside of local/dev environments, so this kind of misconfiguration is caught immediately rather than silently shipping broken links to users.
